review_findings.summary: Read-only adversarial review of the 4-agent merge. 21/21 confirmed. Severity: 2 critical, 1 high, 7 medium, 11 low.
critical: [Vibe/THREAD-002] src/mcp-server.ts: all 6 MCP tools declare outputSchema but return Pi-style {content, details} with no structuredContent -> under @modelcontextprotocol/sdk@1.29.0 every tool call fails output validation (validateToolOutput throws, converted to an isError result). The entire MCP tool surface is non-functional. Fix: drop outputSchema OR return structuredContent (and use a real object schema).
high: [mine -> resolved as far as possible] The critical MCP failure ships untested; tsc cannot catch the missing structuredContent. A functional MCP test is needed once the bug is fixed.
medium: [Codex/THREAD-003] src/protocols.ts readOptionalFile leaks readFile rejections (dir/race/perm) -> can crash session_start/before_agent_start.
[Vibe/THREAD-002] src/mcp-server.ts asfdk_process_interaction casts an unvalidated string to InteractionType; docs show wrong case. Use z.nativeEnum(InteractionType).
[cross-cutting/Joshua] src/index.ts before_agent_start governance is silently fail-open; any foundation/protocol error drops the Solidarity layer for that turn with no signal.
[test-gap] mcp-server.ts and protocols.ts have no tests; some lifecycle hooks and status assertions were weak (the latter strengthened this session).
low: [Codex] protocols.ts: governance context cached per-session and never reloaded (mid-session .toi/.otoi edits ignored); extractDevOtoi ?? chain shadowing on malformed charter; parse-vs-honor diagnostics conflated.

[Vibe] mcp-server.ts: zero-arg tools use z.object({}) which rejects omitted arguments; z.record output schemas are dropped from the tool listing; `finally { shutdown }` is unreachable after process.exit(1).

[cross-cutting] index.ts re-exports mcp-server.js (pulls the MCP SDK into every Pi extension load); Pi (5 tools) vs MCP (6 tools) are divergent hand-maintained lists; policy enforcement asymmetric (Pi enforces, MCP review advisory).
